subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` and JSON status treat persisted `vectorDims` metadata as vector-store ready, leaving `--deep` as the live sqlite-vec probe?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes an operator-facing status contract from current-process readiness to prior successful vector indexing on the fast path.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers want plain status to report prior successful vector indexing while reserving live sqlite-vec validation for `--deep`.

options.title: Require Live-Probe Semantics
options.body: Ask for revised wording or a separate indexed-vector field if `Vector store: ready` must mean current-process sqlite-vec loadability.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and redirect this PR if maintainers want a broader status model before changing the display semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers want plain status to report prior successful vector indexing while reserving live sqlite-vec validation for `--deep`.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the live PR and is positioned to accept or redirect the status-contract change before merge.
